faculty: Department of Computer Science and Engineering; Department of Mechanical Engineering
duration: 2 years, 120 ECTS credits. Specialisations: Ergonomics and Human Factors; Game Design and Development; Interaction Design; Integrated Product Design; Strategic and Sustainable Design. No single department is named on the programme's own official page — its own 'Research' section names Computer Science research (game design, HCI, interaction design) explicitly, and its entry requirements list Mechanical Engineering as an accepted prior degree alongside Industrial Design; attributed here to both as an inference, not an explicit ownership statement. Fee-category note, unresolved: Chalmers' central fee-schedule page names a higher-priced 'Industrial Design Engineering and Architecture' field (SEK 420,000 total), and this programme's 'Integrated Product Design' specialisation is the likely present-day successor to Chalmers' former standalone 'Industrial Design Engineering' programme — but the programme's current 'Educational area' tag is 'Industrial and Interaction Design', not 'Industrial Design Engineering', and no page explicitly confirms which fee band applies. Recorded at the standard rate as the safer default; needs manual re-verification against Chalmers' own admissions/fee office before trusting either figure as settled.
